basic_info.description: Spectacular unit adjacent to the State Street Playground. Property has full width balcony, tons of light and serene garden views. Open floor plan, gorgeous hardwood floors, gas fireplace and additional park view off the west side. Huge garage with room for parking and storage. The property has been lovingly maintained by the current owner who also made many upgrades for the sale, please see listing agent for details. In a peaceful setting but convenient to all the amenities and restaurants in the Duboce Triangle and Market-Castro. The entire 2-unit property is vacant and 30 Flint can be sold with 28 Flint for $4,250,000, see MLS for details on that listing.
